raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-GTM-SmartPublicFinances",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "A decline in remittance inflows could significantly diminish VAT collections and government net revenues, undermining overall fiscal stability and budget execution.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enhance domestic revenue mobilization tools, dynamic fiscal risk modeling, and tax administration analytics at SAT and MINFIN supported under Component 1 and Component 2.",
      "evidence": "A decline in these inflows could considerably reduce Value-Added Tax (VAT) collections, which account for 49 percent of the government's net income"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Cyberattacks on critical PFM digital portals (such as SICOIN and Guatecompras) could compromise sensitive financial data and disrupt core government operations.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish an Information Security Management System (ISMS) based on ISO 27000, deploy a CSIRT and Security Operation Center (SOC), and build a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS).",
      "evidence": "The digital portals of the State Contracting and Acquisitions Information System, Guatecompras and SICOIN, faced attacks in 2023."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Extreme weather events and natural hazards (floods, landslides, droughts) could damage physical ICT infrastructure and cause service interruptions across PFM platforms.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) under ISO 22301, procure resilient cloud/energy-efficient hardware, and embed climate screening into public investment.",
      "evidence": "75 percent of its population at risk from floods, droughts, and landslides... extreme weather events pose an additional risk"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "System fragmentation and lack of transactional interoperability between core financial systems, state asset registers, and procurement portals lead to duplicate records and inefficient data flows.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop an Integrated PFM Conceptual Model, adopt an Enterprise Architecture framework, and deploy an interoperability platform under Components 1 and 2.",
      "evidence": "Limited interoperability between systems has led to manual processes, duplicate records, and inefficiencies in data flows."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "High turnover and lack of structured career paths for skilled data professionals in the public sector could weaken long-term institutional analytical capacity.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create specific career paths for data professionals, operationalize dedicated Data Analytics Units in MINFIN, SEGEPLAN, and SAT, and conduct structured training under Component 3.",
      "evidence": "Governments also struggle to build and retain analytical capacity due to the lack of structured career paths for data professionals"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Institutional instability or changes in senior leadership within MINFIN and implementing agencies could slow down PFM reform momentum and cause project delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Anchor implementation within the Technical Budget Directorate (DTP), establish a dedicated PIU, and maintain oversight through the Digital Transformation Committee.",
      "evidence": "A common reason for the failure of PFM reforms in previous projects in Guatemala is the lack of adequate preparation and institutional stability"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Low municipal adoption and weak FMIS integration of the Gender-Based Budget Classifier (CPEG) limit tracking and accountability of gender-responsive public spending.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade local government management systems, automate gender budget tagging in subnational IFMIS modules, and provide capacity building for municipal authorities.",
      "evidence": "weak integration into the FMIS (only 112 municipalities out of 340 linked their budget to the CPEG) limits monitoring and accountability."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Complex procurement processes for customized software and IT infrastructure could lead to implementation delays and technical specification mismatches.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize World Bank procurement regulations, leverage standardized MPA technical specifications, and retain specialized procurement expertise in the PIU.",
      "evidence": "PIUs will play a central role in developing technical specifications and managing procurement processes"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Inadequate project prioritization, poor alignment with fiscal constraints, and lack of lifecycle monitoring in public investment lead to project discontinuities and cost overruns.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Redesign SEGEPLAN's planning and investment processes, strengthen ex-ante evaluation and prioritization methodologies, and establish multi-year capital investment planning linked to MTEF.",
      "evidence": "weaknesses impact the effectiveness of investment management, including inadequate prioritization due to poor alignment with financial constraints, frequent project discontinuities"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "High proportions of public expenditure allocated to employee compensation without standardized payroll oversight create fiscal rigidities and resource inefficiencies.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct payroll audits, modernize the Payroll and Pensions Management System, and define methodologies to collect homogenous employment data across government entities.",
      "evidence": "Employee compensation is estimated to represent 40.9 percent of the country's total government expenditure... suggesting inefficiencies and resource allocation inadequacies"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Resistance to organizational change and low institutional buy-in from sectoral ministries could hinder the adoption of evidence-based budgeting and data analytics practices.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy a comprehensive change management and communication strategy, engage leadership across ministries, and establish active interinstitutional coordination bodies.",
      "evidence": "Leadership engagement across institutions will be key to promoting the cultural shift needed to mainstream the use of integrated data"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Delays in approving the Project Operational Manual (POM) or establishing the PIU could delay loan effectiveness and initial disbursement of funds.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Draft the POM using standard MPA templates during early preparation and fast-track key PIU recruitment ahead of loan signing.",
      "evidence": "The adoption of the POM is a condition of effectiveness, and the establishment of the PIU is a withdrawal condition."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Continued reliance on basic descriptive analytics rather than diagnostic or predictive models risks failing to achieve intended policy efficiency and decision-making improvements.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a unified PFM data analytics platform, define explicit AI and advanced analytics use cases, and deliver practical training for data analysts.",
      "evidence": "96 percent of countries in the region rely primarily on descriptive analytics... while the use of diagnostic and predictive analytics remains minimal."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Failure to contract an external audit firm within six months of effectiveness would result in non-compliance with legal covenants and fiduciary oversight requirements.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare draft terms of reference for the independent financial audit firm prior to effectiveness and initiate recruitment immediately upon loan signing.",
      "evidence": "contract an external, independent private audit firm for carrying out financial audits... no later than six (6) months as of the Effective Date"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Historically low tax revenues and narrow fiscal space constrain government capacity to maintain adequate capital investment and sustain public service quality.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Modernize revenue management systems, improve property tax platforms, and execute sector spending reviews to optimize existing operational spending.",
      "evidence": "In fiscal year 2024, central government revenue and expenditures averaged 11.8 percent and 14.1 percent of GDP, respectively. Public investment was low"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Lack of sustained cross-country engagement or institutional alignment could reduce the impact and continuity of the regional Smart PFM Community of Practice.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Formalize the Community of Practice through Memoranda of Understanding with participating Ministries of Finance and partner with regional bodies like COSEFIN.",
      "evidence": "Operationalization of 'Smart PFM' Community of Practice... formalized through a Memorandum of Understanding signed by the Ministries of Finance"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: A decline in remittance inflows could significantly diminish VAT collections and government net revenues, undermining overall fiscal stability and budget execution.
risks.mitigation: Enhance domestic revenue mobilization tools, dynamic fiscal risk modeling, and tax administration analytics at SAT and MINFIN supported under Component 1 and Component 2.
risks.evidence: A decline in these inflows could considerably reduce Value-Added Tax (VAT) collections, which account for 49 percent of the government's net income

risks.description: Cyberattacks on critical PFM digital portals (such as SICOIN and Guatecompras) could compromise sensitive financial data and disrupt core government operations.
risks.mitigation: Establish an Information Security Management System (ISMS) based on ISO 27000, deploy a CSIRT and Security Operation Center (SOC), and build a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS).
risks.evidence: The digital portals of the State Contracting and Acquisitions Information System, Guatecompras and SICOIN, faced attacks in 2023.

risks.description: Extreme weather events and natural hazards (floods, landslides, droughts) could damage physical ICT infrastructure and cause service interruptions across PFM platforms.

risks.evidence: 75 percent of its population at risk from floods, droughts, and landslides... extreme weather events pose an additional risk

risks.description: System fragmentation and lack of transactional interoperability between core financial systems, state asset registers, and procurement portals lead to duplicate records and inefficient data flows.

risks.evidence: Limited interoperability between systems has led to manual processes, duplicate records, and inefficiencies in data flows.
